source_registry.organization: Brazil - Lei no 9.503 Codigo de Transito Brasileiro (Presidencia da Republica)
source_registry.facts_supported: Art.96 vehicle classification: CAMINHONETE = cargo vehicle with gross vehicle weight up to 3,500 kg; CAMIONETA = mixed vehicle carrying passengers and cargo in the same compartment; veiculo de carga may carry two passengers besides driver; LOTACAO = max useful load (kg for cargo / number of persons for passengers); CNH categories by seats/GVW; Art.99 weight/dimension limits set by CONTRAN; Art.109 cargo in passenger vehicles only per CONTRAN norms. Amended by Lei 14.440/2022 and 14.599/2023.

Importacion de Vehiculos: DAM via customs agent + invoice + optional insurance + B/L; NEW vehicles need vehicle ID code, Homologation Registry (Reglamento Nacional de Vehiculos Anexo V) or manufacturer/conformity certificate; USED vehicles under regular regime need Ficha Tecnica (with chartered mechanical engineer) plus a Verifying Entity inspection report confirming technical and emission LMP compliance; index covers antiguedad, kilometraje, siniestrabilidad, steering side, emissions.

source_registry.organization: Argentina Government (ANMAT/Secretaria - tramite LCM via TAD/ARCA)
source_registry.facts_supported: New vehicles need LCM (Licencia para Configuracion de Modelo) and LCA to circulate; for manufacturer/importer via TAD; WP.29 whole-vehicle certification can use CVHE; autos/camionetas with a Brazil CAT can obtain LCM under the Mutual Recognition Agreement (ARM); multistage vehicles need Constancia Tecnica (Decree 196/2025); fees listed as of 01/08/2026.

claims.claim: Brazil (CTB Art.96) classifies CAMINHONETE as a cargo vehicle with GVW up to 3,500 kg and CAMIONETA as a mixed passenger+cargo vehicle in the same compartment; a cargo vehicle may carry only two passengers besides the driver.
claims.source_org: Brazil - Lei no 9.503 Codigo de Transito Brasileiro (Presidencia da Republica)

claims.claim: Brazil defines LOTACAO as maximum useful load (kg for cargo / persons for passengers) and sets GVW/weight limits via CONTRAN (Art.99); carrying cargo in passenger vehicles follows CONTRAN norms (Art.109) - the legal basis for payload/use boundary.
